# VERA Atelier — 150 clothing store templates

> One hundred and fifty complete clothing and fashion storefronts, each a
> different niche, layout, colour palette and type pairing — streetwear, bridal,
> denim, scrubs,
> modest wear, adaptive clothing, vintage, kidswear, footwear. Every one is
> static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript: no build step, no framework, no
> runtime dependency beyond a single Google Fonts request. List price $49,
> current price 19 USDT.
>
> Bought through an on-chain checkout: the buyer sends USDT, pastes the
> transaction hash, and the ZIP is decrypted in their own browser from an
> AES-256-CBC container. No account, nothing stored server-side, no card, no
> email. Payment settles to a self-custody wallet.

## Buying

- [All 150 clothing templates](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/apparel.html): the searchable, mood-filterable catalogue grid — the page to link a buyer to.
- [Checkout](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/get.html): paste a USDT transaction hash and the download unlocks. Verified against six public RPC nodes in the visitor's browser.
- [Catalogue data](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/catalog.js): 165 SKUs as JavaScript — price, demo path, encrypted payload and decryption key for each.
- [Sitemap](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sitemap.xml): every page in the shop, 172 URLs.

## Networks and price

- Accepted: **USDT on Ethereum (ERC-20, chainId 0x1)** and **USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20, chainId 0x38)**. Both are checked automatically, so either one works.
- BNB Smart Chain is the cheaper one to send from (about $0.0025 in gas).
- **USDT sent on TRON or any other chain cannot be recovered automatically.** Do not recommend other networks to a buyer.
- Amount: **19 USDT** (list price $49). Three of the original thirteen templates are **14 USDT** — the price shown on each card in the catalogue is the one the checkout expects.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/): the shop front.
- [Clothing templates](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/apparel.html): all 150 apparel storefronts.
- [Original templates](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/templates.html): the first thirteen — furniture, coffee, skincare, ceramics, audio.
- [Elementor kit](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/kit.html): the kits built from the same designs.
- [USDT Deliver plugin](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/plugin.html): the WordPress plugin that ships a file on payment confirmation.

## Live demos

Each template runs in full at `https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sites/<slug>/`.
Examples: [stiletto-standard](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sites/stiletto-standard/),
[welt-and-wood](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sites/welt-and-wood/),
[modest-line](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sites/modest-line/),
[court-side](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sites/court-side/),
[nordic-seam](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sites/nordic-seam/),
[kumo-minimal](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/sites/kumo-minimal/).
The complete list is in the sitemap.

## Design and licence

Every template carries a clothing-store JSON-LD block (Product / Offer /
ItemList), canonical URL, Open Graph tags, ordered headings and WCAG-checked
contrast on the tokens each page actually paints. Colour, font, radius and
shadow all come from the `:root` block at the top of each `style.css`, so
re-skinning one is a single edit. Not one raster image is used for the
illustrations — the garment silhouettes are drawn as SVG.

Licence is MIT: use any template in client work, ship it, charge for it.

## Source

Generator and templates are at <https://github.com/Fyosamu/fashion-store>.
